requestLivePlan.canonical: async function requestLivePlan(){if(!lab.state.liveEnabled||busy||lab.state.pending)return;let ticket=lab.state.generation;try{const id=lang==='vi'?'vi-whale':'en-whale',fixture=snapshotForFixture(id,0);if(!confirm(lang==='vi'?'Nạp truyện ví dụ tổng hợp để thử provider? Lời đang soạn sẽ được thay bằng ví dụ.':'Load the prepared synthetic story for a provider test? The current draft story will be replaced.'))return;session.loadPreparedExample(fixture.sourceText);lab.update('band',fixture.ageBand);lab.update('goal',fixture.goals[0]);lab.update('notes',fixture.mentorNotes);lab.update('answers',[...fixture.answerNotes,...Array(3-fixture.answerNotes.length).fill('')]);syncDraftEditors();renderStoryNotebook();const started=beginProposal();ticket=started.ticket;refreshProposal();plannerAbort=new AbortController();$('scene-note').textContent=lang==='vi'?'Đang yêu cầu đề xuất cho truyện ví dụ tổng hợp; cảnh chưa đổi.':'Requesting a proposal for a synthetic story; the scene has not changed.';const response=await fetch('/api/planner',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({fixtureId:id,snapshot:started.request}),signal:plannerAbort.signal});const data=await response.json();if(!response.ok)throw Error(data.error??'provider-failed');acceptProposal(data.plan,started.request,ticket,'live');renderLab();}catch(error){plannerError(ticket,error);}finally{plannerAbort=null;$('scene-note').textContent=c().sceneNote;}}

readPlannerConfig.canonical: async function readPlannerConfig(){try{const response=await fetch('/api/config',{cache:'no-store'});if(!response.ok)return;const data=await response.json();lab.setLive(data.enabled===true&&data.configured===true);refreshProposal();}catch{/* Static/offline mode remains useful; no provider is contacted. */}}
